beats.title: 11-6, 7th in a stacked West
beats.text: Five West teams are 13-5 or better.

beats.title: Winning by 6.5 a game
beats.text: 116.8 scored, 110.3 allowed, 7th in the NBA. Atlanta, also 11-6, is +3.1.

beats.title: For real
beats.text: If anything, a win short. And 8-5 since Ja Morant got hurt.

panel.note: Every win by 7 or more. Two losses by a single point.

sources: Records and point differential: Fox Sports standings through Nov 23, checked against CBS Sports and our own game data. Game scores: CBS Sports Trail Blazers schedule. Line: best fit through all 30 teams.
